purpose: A label-blind, fixed-method semantic challenger for the spatial asset selection suite.
encoder: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 using the lab's previously pinned quantized AVX2 ONNX, 256 tokens, attention-masked mean and L2 normalization, CPU single-thread
document: Name/title and human-readable description/text in that order when both exist. Use one value per alias group, choosing name then title and description then text; when the catalog has no description alias, append ordinary descriptive scalar/list fields sorted by key, omitting IDs, links, hashes, and provenance. Asset ID only breaks ties. No task-specific hints, expansion, or per-case overrides.
score: Cosine similarity via dot product against precomputed unit vectors for every catalog candidate. No lexical fusion or query rewriting.

abstention.decision: Return top-1 only when both thresholds pass, otherwise abstain. For singleton catalogs apply the cosine threshold only. Ties sort by ascending asset identifier.

validation: Exactly one immutable prediction per case ID. Record full-precision top two scores in a distinct diagnostics file; hash the candidate data before reading labels or invoking canonical scorer; zero test-tuned thresholds.
limitations: Thresholds are engineering priors, not calibrated probabilities. This is a separated author/challenger workflow with synthetic fixtures, not a human-evaluated or independent holdout.
